item.text: The exporter stops when a page has fewer visible records than requested, but deleted records can make a page short even when more pages remain. I’ll make it follow the gateway’s continuation cursor. Projects avoid this example because they use a larger scan size.

item.text:
Fixed CAT-284. Export pagination now follows the continuation cursor until `null`, so deleted records cannot prematurely end the export. Your example now includes both `i-1` and `i-3`.

Added regression coverage for short pages, empty pages, and empty cursor tokens. All 4 tests pass; `git diff --check` passes.
